business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Backward integration for quality control and sustainability: primary raw material is copper rods made from copper cathodes; the Company has backward-integrated its manufacturing facility to produce oxygen-free copper rods from copper cathodes in-house. About 35%-40% of total copper rod requirement was manufactured in-house from copper cathodes during the three months period ended June 30, 2025 and the last 3 Fiscals, with the remainder purchased from suppliers. Raw material requirements are met through a mix of imports and local procurement; imports constituted about 30%-56% of total raw material requirements during the three months period ended June 30, 2025 and the last 3 Fiscals. Major raw material suppliers include Vedanta Limited, Marubeni Corporation, Union Copper Rod LLC, Hindalco Industries Ltd., Bharat Aluminium Company Ltd. and Ducab Metals LLC, with over ten years of relationship maintained with Vedanta Limited, Union Copper Rod LLC and Hindalco Industries Ltd.

compliance_legal.evidence: Searches conducted February 27-March 2, 2025 and March 19, 2025; prohibitory order imposed March 2, 2025, revoked April 23, 2025; ITD notices dated March 27 and March 31, 2025 under Section 149 for AY2023 and AY2024.
compliance_legal.title: Income tax search and proceedings against Promoters

compliance_legal.detail: Company and Promoters are involved in a few pending litigations; no criminal, tax, or statutory/regulatory proceedings reported by/against Directors, Subsidiary, or KMP.
compliance_legal.evidence: Aggregate amount involved: against Company ₹35.70 million; against Promoters ₹32.96 million (see litigation_summary).
compliance_legal.title: Outstanding litigation involving Company and Promoters

compliance_legal.detail: Company failed to execute hypothecation on a vehicle required under one loan and failed to file Form CHG-1 with the RoC; no notice received from the lender to date but future notice cannot be ruled out.

financial_valuation.detail: Company's own multiples based on Offer Price were not disclosed ([●]) in this extract; listed industry peer multiples are provided for comparison but may not indicate post-listing market price.

financial_valuation.title: Market cap/revenue, market cap/tangible assets, EV/EBITDA multiples not indicative of listing price

financial_valuation.detail: Company reported negative cash flows across operating, investing, and financing activities in the three months ended June 30, 2025 and preceding fiscals; sustained negative cash flow could impact growth and business.
financial_valuation.evidence: Net cash used in operating activities: ₹(37.06)mn Q1FY26, ₹(168.36)mn, ₹21.63mn, ₹375.35mn (other periods); investing activities: ₹(95.65)mn, ₹(75.39)mn, ₹(36.79)mn, ₹(56.49)mn (all negative); financing activities: ₹139.33mn, ₹245.67mn, ₹16.88mn, ₹(318.42)mn.
financial_valuation.title: Negative cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities

financial_valuation.detail: Revenue from exports and imported raw materials create foreign exchange exposure; unhedged exposures assessed daily and residual net exposure hedged via forward contracts after natural hedging, but hedging may not be fully effective.
financial_valuation.evidence: Imported raw material as % of purchases: 55.71% (Q1FY26), 43.67% (FY25), 44.60% (FY24), 29.70% (FY23). Export sales as % of revenue: 11.26%, 13.63%, 13.71%, 18.51% respectively.
financial_valuation.title: Foreign currency fluctuation exposure

financial_valuation.detail: Credit ratings assigned to the Company could be downgraded or withdrawn in the future based on results of operations and financial condition, adversely affecting cost/availability of capital.
financial_valuation.evidence: Ratings as of the RHP date: 'CRISIL A-/Stable' (long-term rating), 'CRISIL A2+' (short-term rating); no downgrade during Q1FY26 and Fiscals 2025, 2024, 2023.
financial_valuation.title: Credit rating downgrade risk

financial_valuation.detail: Part of Net Proceeds is proposed to be used for repayment/prepayment of borrowings including a bridge loan; such repayment will not create tangible assets for the Company and is subject to prepayment penalties.
financial_valuation.evidence: Narrative; detailed loan list referenced in 'Objects of the Offer' (p.103) and 'Financial Indebtedness' (p.379), not included in this extract.
financial_valuation.title: Use of Net Proceeds for loan repayment/prepayment including bridge loan

financial_valuation.detail: Financing arrangements require prior lender consent for changes to capital structure, management/board composition, or issuance of further equity shares; non-compliance could trigger acceleration of repayment or enforcement of security.
financial_valuation.evidence: Outstanding consolidated borrowings as of November 14, 2025: ₹2,061.40 million. No default in loan payment to date.
financial_valuation.title: Restrictive covenants in financing agreements

internal_operational.detail: Over 80% of revenue from operations was derived from supplies to power & transmission, general engineering, and electrical sectors in the three months ended June 30, 2025 and last 3 fiscals; any slowdown in these sectors may impact the business.
internal_operational.evidence: Total revenue from these three sectors: ₹3,339.00 million (81.09% of revenue from operations) Q1FY26; ₹12,951.6 million (87.13%) FY25; ₹10,357.19 million (87.33%) FY24; ₹9,056.47 million (89.54%) FY23.
internal_operational.title: Revenue concentration in power & transmission, general engineering, and electrical sectors

internal_operational.detail: Primary raw materials are copper, aluminium, and insulation material/tin/varnish/wire enamel; prices linked to LME (copper, aluminium) and crude oil (insulation paper, polyester film, tin, varnish); Company may not be able to pass on cost increases to customers.
internal_operational.evidence: Copper Rod/Cathode cost: ₹3,666.20mn (92.09% of purchases) Q1FY26; ₹12,987.43mn (93.87%) FY25; ₹10,834.31mn (96.51%) FY24; ₹9,127.51mn (96.19%) FY23. Aluminium Rod: 1.82%-3.06% of purchases across periods.
internal_operational.title: Raw material price/supply volatility (copper, aluminium, insulation materials)

internal_operational.detail: Company is subject to inspection/pre-qualification audits by customers who assess operating facilities before placing orders; requires UL approval for exports to the USA; some prospective customers have not placed orders post-audit in the past.
internal_operational.evidence: Successful conversion of pre-qualification audit to orders: 70.00% (Q1FY26), 78.57% (FY25), 70.00% (FY24), 100.00% (FY23).
internal_operational.title: Customer pre-qualification and pre-order audits

internal_operational.detail: Continuous operation of Anand, Gujarat manufacturing facilities is critical; facilities subject to equipment/power breakdown, labour disputes, natural disasters, and industrial accidents.
internal_operational.evidence: 'While there has been no such stoppage, breakdown or shutdown of plant and machinery during the three months period ended June 30, 2025, and the last 5 Fiscals, we cannot assure you that such instances will not occur in the future.'
internal_operational.title: Manufacturing facility disruption/breakdown risk

internal_operational.detail: Copper-based products (enamelled copper winding wires/strips, paper insulated copper conductors, bare copper wire/rod, PV ribbon copper) contribute over 93% of revenue; any slowdown in copper product demand would adversely impact the business.
internal_operational.title: High revenue concentration in copper-based products (>93%)

internal_operational.detail: Company does not have formal long-term agreements for supply of products or raw materials with most suppliers/customers, despite long-standing relationships with several.
internal_operational.evidence: % of customers having long-term relationship: 30.50% (Q1FY26), 21.17% (FY25), 20.38% (FY24), 21.41% (FY23); % of raw material suppliers having long-term relationship: 15.15%, 6.67%, 7.69%, 7.04% respectively. Top 5 customers contributed 16.74%-23.76% of total sales across periods.
internal_operational.title: No long-term agreements with most raw material suppliers/customers

strategy_growth.detail: Use of Net Proceeds has not been appraised by any external independent agency, bank, or financial institution and is based on management estimates that may change with market conditions.
strategy_growth.evidence: 'The objects of the Fresh Issue and deployment of funds have not been appraised by any external agency or any bank or financial institution or any other independent agency and are based on management estimates.'
strategy_growth.title: Objects of Fresh Issue/fund deployment based on unappraised management estimates

strategy_growth.detail: Company has placed orders for only part of the plant and machinery to be funded from Net Proceeds, exposing it to time/cost overrun risk on the remaining unordered equipment.
strategy_growth.evidence: 'We have already placed orders for certain plant and machinery aggregating to ₹228.42 million... orders for the remaining portion of the total capital expenditure towards the purchase of plant and machinery are yet to be placed.'
strategy_growth.title: Plant & machinery purchase orders partly unplaced

strategy_growth.detail: Industry is fragmented with unbranded players enjoying a price advantage; Company competes on product quality/reliability, technical/production capability, delivery, and price against established players.
strategy_growth.evidence: 'As per the CareEdge Report, the market share of the Company for Fiscal 2025 is 5.7%.' Key competitors named: Precision Wires India Limited, Ram Ratna Wires Limited, Apar Industries Limited.
strategy_growth.title: Competitive pressures in the winding and conductivity products industry

strategy_growth.detail: Any variation in the disclosed use of Net Proceeds requires shareholder special resolution and a dissenting-shareholder exit offer from Promoters, potentially limiting the Company's flexibility to redeploy funds.
strategy_growth.evidence: Narrative; governed by Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI ICDR Regulations Schedule XX.
strategy_growth.title: Restrictions on variation of Net Proceeds utilization

strategy_growth.detail: Success of the business depends on effectively managing expansion projects and implementing strategy; execution depends on financing availability/terms, regulatory approvals, and general economic conditions.
strategy_growth.evidence: Narrative; no company-specific figures provided in this extract.
strategy_growth.title: Execution risk on business strategy/expansion plans

strategy_growth.detail: Changes in client preferences, regulatory requirements, or competing technologies could render products obsolete; no assurance the Company can secure the technological knowledge needed to remain competitive.
strategy_growth.title: Failure to anticipate evolving industry trends/new product development
